structs.notes: Resolved. Confirmed layout: base up to 34584, timeoutcount 34584, inline snap 34592 (119000), header 153592..153632 with serverTime at 153600, parse indexes 153632..153656, kick angles 153664 and the 160-byte predicted copy 153676..153836, parse counts and pointers 153836..153944, svCmd error pair 153952/153960, burstState 154040, frame rings 154048 (ints), 154560 (ints), 155072 (160-byte slots up to 175552), trailer 175552..175576. The chain of game-test offsets is shifted by 24136 up to 153684, by 24104 after the omnvars pointer (no game-test weapon-count fields), by 24088 from 153952 (the disconnectPercentage and svCmdMaxDurationMsec fields are absent), and by -1536 for the 160-byte ring element (172 in game-test). The ClActiveClient base must end at 34584 for the timeoutcount proof; that is the one change outside this struct.
